name: Game Event Time
description: Absolute date window for date-scheduled game events (game_event.schedule_type = 1 DATE): the event never starts before start_time nor after end_time; within the window it follows the event's occurence/length cycle.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Game event id (game_event.entry). The referenced event must have schedule_type 1 (DATE), otherwise the row is ignored.

fields.name: Start Time
fields.help: Absolute start date (DATETIME, e.g. 2010-12-15 06:00:00); the event will never start before this date.

fields.name: End Time
fields.help: Absolute end date (DATETIME); the event will never start after this date.
